## Publication Information

**Date:** 1869

**Genre:** theology

**Publisher:** London: J. and C. Mozley

**Notes:** CMY refers to this among her own works in a letter to Macmillan, so although the book is anonymous, and not listed by Coleridge, the attribution seems safe.  It is listed, undated, by Battiscombe and Laski as owned by a member of the CMY Society.
